persona_scripts.material: Carved stone monument adorned with traditional royal Kaba cloak, chest clasp, and embroidered Kemis with an ornate belt medallion.
persona_scripts.craft: Sculpted to honor Empress Taytu Betul's noble dignity, regal attire, and decisive military intelligence as Empress of Ethiopia.
persona_scripts.usage: Empress Taytu led her own 6,000-strong force at Adwa and devised the vital siege strategy that cut off the enemy's water supply at Meqele.
